senses.gloss: कैकय m. the king of the Kekayas, BhP. ix, 24, 37
कैकय m. pl. the sons of that king, ib.
कैकय m. (= केक्˚) the Kekayas, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
कैकयी f. the daughter of a king of the Kekayas, R.
कै॑केय m. (Pāṇ. vii, 3, 2) ‘a descendant of Kekaya’, prince of the Kekayas, ŚBr. x; ChUp.
N. of a son of Śivi (from whom the Kaikeyas are derived), Hariv. 1680; BhP. ix, 23, 3
N. of Dhṛṣṭaketu (king of the Kaikeyas and father of the five Kaikeyas), VP.
कै॑केय m. pl. the Kekayas, R.
कै॑केय n. the language of the Kekayas.
कै॑केयी f. the daughter of a prince of the Kekayas (one of the wives of Daśa-ratha and mother of Bharata, R.; Ragh.), MBh.; Daś.
कैकस m. patr. fr. कीकस, g. शार्ङ्गरवादि
कैकसी f. N. of a daughter of the Rākṣasa Sumālin, R. vii, 5, 40 and 9, 7.
